input.summary: Ported reduction.cu + kernels.h to idiomatic SYCL 2020 in migrated/reduction_sycl.cpp and migrated/kernels.h (reduction_input.hpp unchanged). The port has no dpct helpers, no DPCT_* macros and no dpct includes; the c2s-generated reduction.dp.cpp and MainSourceFiles.yaml were removed. Design: one templated grid-stride kernel template<int V> using sycl::atomic_ref<int, relaxed, device, global_space>::fetch_add once per work-item, launched with a 1-D nd_range<1>(grid*block, block); an in-order queue with malloc_device, q.memset, q.memcpy. Compiles with icpx -fsycl and no dpct include (0 warnings). Ran ./candidate: all 20 float64 sums equal the CPU reference sum (8388608) exactly, 0 mismatches. Not verified against the original CUDA binary, since no CUDA device is available here.
